name: KAAAH Car Finder
author: benign01

sections.description:
KAAAH Car Finder gives visitors a clear route into KAAAH’s independent UK personalised car-matching service. Add it with the KAAAH Car Finder block or the [kaaah_car_finder] shortcode.

Customers answer 56 detailed questions about their driving, journeys, budget, comfort, performance and practical requirements. KAAAH then provides three detailed recommendations, five further alternatives and version-level buying guidance.

The plugin’s display script is bundled locally. It does not collect questionnaire answers or personal information on the WordPress site. When a visitor chooses to start, they leave the WordPress site and continue on kaaah.co.uk.

External service

When a visitor clicks the widget, they are taken to https://kaaah.co.uk/ to use the KAAAH car-matching service. If the site owner has entered a partner code, that code is included in the destination URL so KAAAH can attribute the active browser-tab visit and any verified purchase. See https://kaaah.co.uk/partners/terms/ for partner terms.

Shortcode options

[kaaah_car_finder]

[kaaah_car_finder theme=”dark” button=”Find my ideal car”]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate KAAAH Car Finder.
  3. Open Settings > KAAAH Car Finder.
  4. Optionally enter a referral code supplied by KAAAH. The widget also works without one.
  5. Add the KAAAH Car Finder block, or use [kaaah_car_finder].

The questionnaire, payment and customer report remain securely on kaaah.co.uk. The plugin does not collect questionnaire answers or personal information. Its display code is bundled inside the plugin; it does not download executable code from KAAAH.
sections.faq:
Do I need a KAAAH partner code?

No. The widget works without a partner code. A code is only needed if you have joined the KAAAH partner programme and want eligible purchases attributed to you.

Does the plugin collect visitor information?

No. The plugin does not collect questionnaire answers or personal information on your WordPress site. Visitors continue to kaaah.co.uk when they choose to start.

Can I change the button text or appearance?

Yes. The block includes light and dark themes and editable button text. Shortcode users can set the theme and button attributes.

Is the car-matching report free?

Visitors can complete the questionnaire and see their initial match before deciding whether to purchase the full report. Current pricing is shown on kaaah.co.uk.
